title: Spicy Crab and Shrimp Salad
description: A refreshing seafood salad featuring crab, shrimp, and crunchy vegetables, served with a zesty Indian-inspired dressing.
instructions: 1. Peel and de-vein shrimp, then chop into bite-sized pieces.
2. In a large bowl, combine shrimp, crab meat, cucumber, carrots, red onion, and cilantro.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, garam masala, and honey.
4. Pour dressing over seafood mixture and toss to coat.
5. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
6. Just before serving, stir in crunchy Indian flatbread.
7. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
8. Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
9. Serve with additional flatbread on the side, if desired.
